failed_jobs.symptom: Install TF Models tests requirements step failed: pip install crashed with JSONDecodeError while parsing the internal pip-proxy index page for a TensorFlow/transformers dependency

key_errors:
ERROR: Exception:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "pip\_internal\index\collector.py", line 228, in parse_links
    data = json.loads(page.content)
  File "json\decoder.py", line 355, in raw_decode
    raise JSONDecodeError("Expecting value", s, err.value) from None
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
root_cause: The 'Install TF Models tests requirements' step runs `pip install -r requirements_tensorflow` through the runner's internal pip-proxy (PIP_INDEX_URL=http://pip-proxy.pip-proxy.svc.cluster.local/simple/). While resolving a dependency of transformers==4.45.1 (immediately after collecting h5py for keras), pip's JSON-based simple-index API v2 client tried to parse the proxy's response body as JSON and got an empty/non-JSON body ('Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)'), which pip's resolver treats as a fatal error rather than retrying. This subsequently cascaded: because the requirements install failed, pytest was never installed, so the downstream 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (read_model)' step also failed with 'No module named pytest'. This is an internal package-proxy infrastructure hiccup, not caused by PR #37208 (which only reformats GPU plugin header braces via clang-tidy and touches no Python test/requirements files).
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reliably reproducible locally; requires hitting the internal pip-proxy (pip-proxy.pip-proxy.svc.cluster.local) at the exact moment it returns a truncated/empty index page for one of the requirements_tensorflow dependencies.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'NPU Models Tests / 4000' job; a plain retry is expected to succeed once the pip-proxy serves a valid index page.
If this recurs frequently, add retry/backoff around `pip install` steps for Windows TF/NPU test jobs (e.g., `--retries` or a wrapping retry action) to absorb transient proxy hiccups.
No code changes are required in PR #37208.
prevention_strategies: Consider pinning a stable pip resolver mode or adding `pip install --retries 5` with exponential backoff for requirements installs that go through pip-proxy, since a single truncated JSON response from the proxy currently fails the whole step immediately.
historical_context: No prior investigation with this exact signature was found in the CI Doctor MQ pattern database; this is the first recorded occurrence. A related but distinct pip/PyPI JSON error (pattern eb85200a77e84af0, 'Unterminated string' on grpcio) was recorded 2026-06-29 for a Linux Build job; and a different pip-proxy DNS-resolution failure (pattern 4af26ac5e3256c5f) was recorded 2026-08-26 for GPU RoPE tests. Both are separate infrastructure/network hiccups, consistent with intermittent pip-proxy reliability issues rather than a recurring single root cause.
